description: This Java class, HolidayHelper, provides utility methods for managing holiday-related operations within the Apache Fineract integration tests, such as creating, activating, retrieving, and deleting holidays via REST API calls.

classes.name: HolidayHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to create, activate, fetch, and delete holiday entries in the Fineract system during integration testing.

methods.name: getCreateHolidayDataAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for creating a holiday with default dates and random name.

methods.name: getCreateType1HolidayDataAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for creating a specific type of holiday with fixed date.

methods.name: getActivateHolidayDataAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for activating a holiday (empty payload).

methods.name: createHolidays
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST request to create a holiday, returning the resource ID.

methods.name: createTyoe1Holidays
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST request to create a specific type of holiday, returning the resource ID.

methods.name: activateHolidays
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST request to activate a holiday by ID.
